import json


def export(value, ctx, **options):
    import vl_convert

    spec = value.to_dict()
    config = dict(spec.get("config") or {})
    axis = dict(config.get("axis") or {})
    axis["grid"] = False
    config["axis"] = axis
    spec["config"] = config

    scale = options.get("scale", 2)
    blob = ctx.write_blob(
        "chart-nogrid.png",
        vl_convert.vegalite_to_png(
            vl_spec=json.dumps(spec, allow_nan=False),
            scale=scale,
        ),
        media_type="image/png",
    )
    return {
        "format_id": "image.png.nogrid.v1",
        "media_type": "image/png",
        "data": {
            "type": "bundle",
            "files": {"image": blob},
            "entry": "image",
        },
        "metadata": {
            "source_format": "vegalite.v1",
            "grid": False,
            "scale": scale,
        },
    }
